messages:
lina: quick docs PR to normalize examples for /generate (header casing + example status). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12678
rahul: what's the mismatch?
lina: curl and one Go snippet used `X-Request-Id` while our SDKs and examples use `x-request-id`. also one example showed 202 but /generate returns 200 for sync calls.
marc: backend is case-insensitive but proxies can be picky — worth fixing. small migration note would help.
lina: adding a one-liner under Notes: 'Examples use lowercase header names (x-request-id) for broader proxy compatibility.' and changing example status to 200.
docs-ci-bot: examples lint: fail 
- example status 202 not in OpenAPI responses for /generate
- header casing mismatch detected between curl and SDK snapshots
lina: updated curl snippet: ```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-request-id: $(uuidgen)" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-1","input":"Summarize this"}'
```
rahul: can we add a tiny docs test later to snapshot curl examples and assert header casing + status code? helps avoid regressions.
marc: agreed. for release: if docs cause a flaky check, revert docs edit rather than block release.
lina: filed follow-up issue for example snapshot test and changelog note. rebasing now and will ping when CI green :white_check_mark:
